verdict.rationale: Working Copy has its own documented programmatic surface: an x-callback-url scheme with command deep links gated by an app-generated secret key, plus Shortcuts actions. It is iOS deep-link automation documented only in prose, not a conventional public API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. missing for 10: machine-readable schema/OpenAPI, network-accessible API (REST/HTTP), interactive reference, test mode, versioning/deprecation policy, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Commands that change data or read content out of Working Copy are protected by a secret key
Use Shortcuts and x-callback-url for automation.
Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.
